text:
olivia: Quick heads-up — Spring Pulse townhall next Wed 10:00am PT. Format: 45m presentations + 15m live Q&A. Please drop any questions in this thread or add them to the intake doc (link below). :calendar:

sam: Thanks — will kick off with a short company health update. Can we keep exec remarks to 10m?

maria: Yep, decks are mostly final. Uploaded in the shared doc: https://docs.redwood.internal/spring-pulse-deck (please comment by Mon EOD).

olivia: Agenda draft inlined below — callouts welcome.

```Agenda
- 10:00 Intro & company health (Sam) - 10m
- 10:10 Product roadmap highlights (Maria) - 12m
- 10:22 Launch callouts + infra readiness (Tom) - 8m
- 10:30 Dedicated & Private updates (Leah) - 7m
- 10:37 Ops & reliability summary (Nishant) - 8m
- 10:45 Live Q&A - 15m
```

tom: For the infra slide, I'll include region capacity and recent throughput tests. Want a short note on the fallback routing change we rolled out last week?

ben: Can we add an incident summary slide about last week's cache eviction regression? Should be 2 bullets max.

nishant: I'll prepare the ops summary and include SLO/latency graphs and the quick incident RCA blurb. Ben — if you paste 2 bullets in the doc I'll copy them to the ops slide.

maria: Also request: product needs 1 Q about Dedicated pricing/commit tiers — add to Q list so we can prep an answer.

olivia: Good note. Folks, if you can't attend, drop the question + desired phrasing in the intake doc and we'll ask on your behalf. Intake doc: https://docs.redwood.internal/spring-pulse-intake (single sheet for Qs + slide comments).

devops-bot: Calendar invite sent to #all-hands and company-all.ics — meeting created for 2026-05-06 10:00 PT.

sam: Recording will be posted in this channel within 24h after the call; we'll also pin the exec deck and action tracker.

leah: I'll cover Dedicated roadmap highlights and the new private-deploy checklist. If anyone has compliance callouts to include, ping me.

ben: Adding the incident bullets to the intake doc now.

maria: Quick ask — can we surface a single customer story (30s) about a latency improvement from Redwood Optimize? Tiny slide, helps tie metrics to customer value.

olivia: Love that. Maria, can you add a 1-liner and the customer logo (approved) to the deck?

maria: On it.

tom: One more — I'll paste the infra readiness checklist in the doc under slides so ops can verify before the call.

olivia: Thanks all — last call for agenda changes. Please add Qs/notes by Monday 5pm PT. :raised_hands:

ben: Thanks — will do.

nishant: Will upload SLO graphs by Monday morning.

olivia: Postnotes: recording link (posted after meeting), deck link (see doc), and a short action item tracker will go up in #all-hands-followups. If you want a specific action assigned, add your initials in the action tracker.

sam: TL;DR for execs: concise metrics + one product highlight + 2 operational callouts.

olivia: End of thread — feel free to @ me if something urgent pops up.
